items.query: What is formula for Scaled Dot-Product Attention?
items.response:
The formula for Scaled Dot-Product Attention is: 

Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k))V

items.query: What is the Time complexity for Linked List for insertion, deletion, searching?
items.response: The time complexity for Linked List for insertion is O(1), and for deletion and searching is O(n).
